messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — High error rate affecting customer AcmeCorp (dedicated-pool-7, vpc-42). 5xxs on /v1/generate, observed spike at 09:14 UTC. Paging oncall.

alice (oncall): Ack. I'm pulling logs and checking pool health. Anyone seeing infra-level alerts for that pool?

sam (sre): I see GPU memory OOMs for some replicas in dedicated-pool-7 starting ~09:12. Replica restarts + backpressure. Likely model KV growth due to long-context requests from the tenant.

jordan (solutions): AcmeCorp confirmed they ramped a batch job this morning — long-prefix usage. Might explain KV cache pressure. They need stable latency; they're on Dedicated with tenant isolation.

kevin (eng-runtime): Repro logs look like repeated attention cache growth. Dumped a trace: ```
[09:12:48] replica-3: kv_cache_size=12.8GB
[09:12:49] replica-3: OOM signal, restart
[09:12:51] replica-1: serving, degraded perf
[09:13:05] proxy: 502 upstream reset
```

alice (oncall): We need a live mitigation that doesn't require infra scaling changes (customer is on a committed pool with limited headroom). Options: 1) Apply tenant-level request limits, 2) Pin their served model to a safe variant with smaller KV footprint, 3) Route them to a fallback model in a different pool.

sam (sre): Fastest safe option: apply a model-override to force a deterministic small-ctx variant and avoid long-prefix KV growth. We can pin AcmeCorp to model: rdx-small-1-safe or rdx-quant-7b-slim. This is a config change in routing rules.

kevin (eng-runtime): Agreed. I can push an override rule to the control plane. Proposed rule (console CLI): ```
# pin tenant acmecorp to a safe variant until further notice
redwoodctl routing rules create \
  --tenant acmecorp \
  --match ":path_prefix /v1/generate" \
  --override-model "rdx-quant-7b-slim" \
  --reason "incident: OOMs in dedicated-pool-7" \
  --ttl 2h
```

alice (oncall): Nice. Before applying, confirm compatibility: will the fallback model support their required functions (tool-calls, streaming)?

kevin (eng-runtime): rdx-quant-7b-slim supports streaming and basic tool-calls but not every custom ffunc they've added. If we need feature parity, rdx-small-1-safe is better but slightly heavier. For immediate stability pick quant-7b-slim.

maria (cs): We should communicate to AcmeCorp asap. Draft customer text: "We're seeing elevated errors on your workloads in your dedicated pool due to long context usage. As a temporary mitigation we've pinned your traffic to a stable model variant that reduces memory usage. This may slightly change output characteristics. We'll update when normal service is restored." Thoughts?

jordan (solutions): Good. Add guidance for them to pause the batch job if possible. Also offer to schedule a post-incident call to discuss proper KV limits / batching.

alice (oncall): I'll apply the override and add a circuit-breaker rule to limit extremely long requests (>120k tokens) from the tenant until we can scale. Command: ```
redwoodctl limits set --tenant acmecorp --max-tokens 120000 --scope request --reason "mitigation"
```

sam (sre): Applying both now. I'll watch for replica restarts and error rate. If errors drop to baseline within 5 mins we keep rule; else escalate to infra for capacity add.

ops-bot: action=apply_rule user=kevin rule_id=rl_89ab2c status=queued

kevin (eng-runtime): Pushed the override rule; ID rl_89ab2c. TTL 2h. Also opened a canary route to fallback-pool-3 for 5% of traffic to validate model behavior.

alice (oncall): Observing error rate down from 18% -> 3% over the last 2 minutes. Replica restarts stopped. :thumbsup:

maria (cs): Sent message to customer with note and link to incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/ACME-17587. Will follow up with a postmortem invite.

jordan (solutions): Logging action items: 1) postmortem + model fallback checklist, 2) follow-up with AcmeCorp about batch job and context usage, 3) explore auto-fallback policy when KV metrics exceed threshold.

alice (oncall): Oncall handoff in 1h. @sam please take point for escalation if errors resurge. Leaving summary in PagerDuty note.

sam (sre): Taking handoff. Monitoring dashboards + alerting thresholds tightened for dedicated-pool-7. Will update status channel if anything changes.

alice (oncall): Thanks team. Closing thread when monitoring stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
